lines.text: 2. A trusted adapter enumerates a finite, typed, legal **pre-sampling** assignment support under hard known capacity/permissions, and exports a bounded role-aware GraphDataIR.

MechanicalWorkflows owns pure coordination composition, typed Intents and deterministic reconcile/admission; native hosts own effects. GraphPolicyCLI is an external optional pure adapter for scoring observed agent/task/resource/capability graphs. It neither schedules work nor claims tool effects, and does not reinterpret mw.training-export.v1 post-proposal admission as the policy's pre-sampling eligible support.

Host: obtain bounded typed graph and **pre-sampling** legal candidates → GP scores keyed agent/task pairs → a named selector samples with actual behavior log probability or selects deterministic proposal → host maps symbolic choice into typed Intent with expected source revision → MechanicalWorkflows reconcile enforces conflicts, protected scopes, limits and staleness → native executor runs accepted action → verifiers report actual outcome.

Add an application-owned sidecar rather than changing `mw.training-export.v1` admission semantics. Record exact GP graph/program/checkpoint, feature projection, actor/selector, legal support at sample time, proposed vs admitted vs executed action, actual source receipt and final feedback status. Post-proposal admission is **not** original sampler support. Unknown/pending feedback cannot be invented as observed reward; global team outcome alone does not attribute causal benefit to each actor.
